name: GetLatka

sources.title: GetLatka — Nathan Latka's SaaS revenue-data platform + CEO-interview podcast; 72,000+ company database; free account for access; paid $49-99/mo; company pages at /companies/<slug> carry revenue/growth metrics

conditions: There is no public submit form — companies enter the database through Latka's data operation (scraped metrics + CEO interviews); the route to being featured is the interview pipeline or their data collection
requirements: SaaS company with real metrics — the database is built on CEO-confirmed revenue data
Being featured means a Nathan Latka interview ('revenue confirmed on camera') or inclusion via their data collection
Reader access: free account; full data $49-99/mo
No submission form observed on the public site
preparation: Real revenue/growth numbers you can defend — Latka interviews press for specifics
A pitch for the podcast/interview format
workflow: Pitch an interview via Latka's channels (podcast guest route)
If interviewed, a company page and interview post are published with the disclosed metrics
Alternatively the company may enter the database automatically via their data ops
watchFor: The interview format demands transparency — revenue figures are published publicly
Not a launch directory — the database values companies by metrics, not launches
Claiming/updating a company page isn't documented publicly
countsAsLive: The company has a page at getlatka.com/companies/<slug> with metrics/interview
unknowns: How to request a new company entry absent an interview
Whether company data can be corrected by the company itself
